{{Quote|Now I'll show you a power even greater than the coming darkness!|Charal to Logray|<ref name="Shadows of Endor" />}}
A '''skirmish''' occurred in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]] when [[Logray/Legends|Logray]], the [[Shaman/Legends|shaman]] of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], and his assistant [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]] met the [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomiri]] [[Witch/Legends|witch]] named [[Charal]] in her lair. While the two Ewoks had only come to speak out their concerns about the recents events that plagued [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], the conversation turned sour when Charal tried to seize the [[Sunstar/Legends|Sunstar]], a powerful artifact wielded by Logray.<ref name="Shadows of Endor" />
